question: What functional unit does the life-cycle assessment of resource recovery from spent FCC catalysts use, and in what software and with what primary impact assessment method were impacts calculated?
expect: treatment of 1 t of spent FCC catalyst; SimaPro 10.1 with Environmental Footprint (EF) 3.1 (adapted) (abstract; sec. 2)
trap: ReCiPe 2016 (used only for a supplementary comparison)
rendered:
The functional unit used in the life-cycle assessment of resource recovery from spent FCC catalysts is the treatment of 1 t of spent FCC catalyst.

The impacts were calculated using the software SimaPro 8.0.3 and with the primary impact assessment method, ReCiPe 2016 Midpoint (H).
